verdict.rationale: The docs show the server is started from the command line with `local-ai run <model>` (also via Docker `docker run ... localai/localai`). They also document CLI flags such as `--preload-models` and `--external-grpc-backends`, and a `local-ai models list` subcommand. Nothing in the evidence covers stopping the server or managing its lifecycle from the CLI, so only half of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: documented stop/shutdown command or daemon lifecycle management, server status command, independent hands-on corroboration.
